evidence.quoted_text:
def atomic(filename, data):
    filename = Path(filename)
    durable_directory(filename.parent)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
    fsync_dir(filename.parent)
evidence.reason: The current `atomic` helper still leaks its staging file on failure. `temporary = stream.name` is assigned only after `stream.write`, `stream.flush` and `os.fsync` succeed, and `os.replace` is outside any cleanup block. Because `NamedTemporaryFile(..., delete=False)` does not unlink on close, an exception in fsync or replace leaves the named temp file in the artifact directory; retries create additional orphans. This is an ordinary minor error-path defect in the existing durable-write implementation, and the suggested fix (capture the name before writing and unlink in `finally` while keeping the post-replace directory sync) is the smallest compatible repair.
